description: This file is a shell script used for testing git operations related to cherry-picking and reverting merge commits. It sets up git repositories, runs various git commands (like cherry-pick and revert with -m options), and checks for expected outcomes.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expected to succeed, runs provided shell commands, and checks for success.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Runs a command expecting a specific exit code.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, and reports failure if it does not.
